FileSessionLoader implements PrepLoader: read-only discovery honouring accept, counting skipped symlinks and hidden entries, stat, anchors, batches, record_at at an offset that must begin a complete line., Done means Incremental and idempotent: `unisphere prep --target DIR` over explicit or default roots publishes tables atomically. A re-run with nothing changed reads zero body bytes and writes zero rows. Appended sources contribute only records after the committed cursor. Replaced, truncated, or same-size rewritten sources start a new generation and the canonical views never contain rows from a superseded generation. A crash mid-run leaves the previous publication intact and the next run recovers without duplicates. (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-0001); Live files never fail: a source being appended during the run is committed to its last complete line; the partial tail is reported (bytes pending) and picked up by the next run. Proven with a concurrent non-line-aligned writer and on the real live fleet. (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-0002); CLI and SDK parity: prep is composed from public SDK/core ports (loader, pure fold, store) with no CLI-only semantics; an external SDK consumer can run the same incremental prep in-process with its own store. The core/SDK ports carry no Parquet, SQLite or engine dependency. The adapter catalogue reports persisted resume as supported for every harness prep covers. (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-0003); Honest coverage: every run reports per-source outcome (unchanged, appended, replaced, new, skipped, unreadable, unsupported) and counts skipped symlinks and hidden entries; extra roots (for example a second Claude account under ~/.claude-alt) are explicit inputs. Nothing is silently excluded. (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-0007); Contexts are gold, cheaply: expensive-turn and call rows carry a native address (path plus byte offset) so an agent can fetch exactly that record with explicit content opt-in, without re-reading the transcript. (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-000a). Interface: unisphere_sdk::prep::{Preparer, PrepBinding, fold_source, SourceFold, PrepResume}; FileSessionLoader: PrepLoader..
